            }
        } catch (IOException e) {

    private static class Point {
        int v, w, x, y, z;
        
        Point(int v, int w, int x, int y, int z) {

            this.w = w;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.z = z;
        }

                this.v - other.v,
                this.w - other.w,
                this.x - other.x,
                this.y - other.y,
                this.z - other.z
            );
        }
        
        double magnitude() {
            return Math.sqrt(v*v + w*w + x*x + y*y + z*z);
        }
    }
    
    private static double dotProduct(Point a, Point b) {
        return (double)(a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z);
    }
